sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Cow's milk, sometimes with goat's milk, is warmed first.
Starter cultures and rennet go in together.
It is heated and stirred to firm it and drive out whey.

steps.name: cheddar the curd
steps.note: The curd is kept warm and turned several times as it knits, draining more whey, much as Cheddar is made.
It is cut again into smaller pieces.
It ages only briefly, long enough to develop flavour and texture.
